answer.rationale: The two live symptoms (activation -6% QoQ, onboarding completion -4% QoQ) point at the same funnel stage, and two independent inherited records (memory_86 on shortened onboarding, memory_31 on signup field reduction) support intervening there. I am verifying memory_86 because it is the closest match to the observed regression and the single largest driver of my choice, and memory_91 because activation messaging is the nearest rival direction and I want to know whether its 'week-one engagement' lift was ever tied to durable revenue before discarding it. I am deliberately not spending budget on memory_73: it already carries its own warning (31% conversion lift, 18% revenue, but retention down 12 points later in the cycle), and that pattern is exactly why I will not answer the competitor's entry pricing with promotional_pricing — matching a price war on price-sensitive SMB accounts buys reported revenue that decays and does not qualify as sustainable. referral_incentive (memory_57) is sound but targets established customers, which is not where the bleeding is. enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is a different segment entirely and does not address the QoQ drop. Key uncertainty I am preserving: every supporting memory for onboarding measures early-funnel outcomes only — completion, time-to-value, first-week activation — and none of them report late-cycle retention or revenue quality. memory_73 is the standing proof that this company has previously mistaken an early-funnel lift for a durable win. So the downstream risk is concrete: stripping onboarding steps or signup fields can raise completion while admitting lower-intent accounts and starving later personalization, producing the same short-term-up/long-term-down shape. I am therefore running this as a standard experiment rather than a broad rollout, with success gated on 60-90 day retention and qualified-revenue-per-cohort, not on completion rate. Also worth stating: the current dip may be partly competitor-driven mix shift rather than a genuine onboarding defect, so I will hold a clean control and treat a completion-only improvement as a non-result.
